subject: Still waiting for my furniture — and my money back
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain in the strongest terms about an order I placed with LUMIERE DECOR SARL through your bank's online platform on 2026-09-10. The total was 129,000 HUF, and delivery was promised by 2026-09-25. That date has long passed and nothing has arrived. I have emailed the merchant repeatedly, but they simply do not answer. This is completely unacceptable.

My customer reference is C-1009. I have no confidence that the furniture will ever be delivered, so I want the full amount of 129,000 HUF refunded to my account without further delay. Please confirm in writing what you are doing about this and when I can expect my money back.

Yours faithfully,
Sophie Laurent

draft.body:
Dear Sophie Laurent,

Thank you for contacting us about the furniture you paid for but did not receive. We have reviewed your complaint, and because it concerns a card payment to a merchant, it will be handled by our Card Disputes specialist team, who will give you a final answer no later than 12 November 2026.

You authorised this card purchase, so it is not treated as an unauthorised transaction and no immediate refund applies. [1] Where goods paid for by card are not delivered, the first step is to contact the merchant, and if the merchant does not resolve the issue, the bank initiates a chargeback through the card scheme. [1] A chargeback is not a refund decision by the bank: the outcome depends on the merchant's response, which typically takes about 45 days. [1]

The specialist team will contact you to request your order confirmation and your correspondence with the merchant, and will explain the expected timeline. [1]

If you are not satisfied with the final answer, you may turn to the Pénzügyi Békéltető Testület or the Magyar Nemzeti Bank (mnb.hu/fogyasztovedelem).

Yours sincerely,
Danubia Bank Complaints Team

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: Before the loss or theft of the card is reported, the customer may bear losses up to HUF 15,000, unless the transaction was made without strong customer authentication, in which case the customer bears no loss. Online transactions without strong customer authentication (SCA) are refunded in full.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If goods or services paid by card were not delivered or were materially different from what was ordered, the customer should first contact the merchant. If the merchant does not resolve the issue, the bank initiates a chargeback through the card scheme. The chargeback is not a refund decision of the bank: the outcome depends on the merchant's response, typically within 45 days. The answer to the customer must explain that the chargeback was initiated, what documents are needed (order confirmation, correspondence with the merchant), and the expected timeline.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If the same card authorisation (same authorisation code) was settled twice, the second debit is an error of the bank and is refunded in full without waiting for the merchant.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If a customer reports a card or account transaction they did not authorise, the bank refunds the amount immediately and at the latest by the end of the following business day after the report. The only exception is when the bank has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud by the customer and reports this in writing to the supervisory authority. The refund may not be delayed while the bank investigates the customer's possible negligence; liability is assessed afterwards.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: When an unauthorised transaction is reported, the card is blocked immediately and a replacement card is sent free of charge.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
retrieved.content: A complaint is upheld when the bank made an error; the customer receives a full refund of the amount wrongly charged plus, for errors causing inconvenience, an optional goodwill credit of up to HUF 5,000 at the handler's discretion. A complaint is partially upheld when only some points are justified; only the justified part is refunded. A complaint is rejected when the bank acted in line with the contract and fee schedule; the answer must explain the applicable rule clearly. Any refund above HUF 200,000 or any decision involving suspected fraud must be escalated to the Complaints Team Lead before approval.

assessment.rationale: The customer authorised the card purchase (SCA passed), so this is not an unauthorised-transaction case and no immediate refund applies. It is a non-delivery merchant dispute, which under cards-and-disputes#4 must go through a chargeback initiated with the card scheme, not a bank refund decision. Chargeback initiation is outside the handler's refund authority and must be escalated to the specialist team, which will also request the order confirmation and merchant correspondence and explain the ~45-day timeline.

**Facts collected (complaint C-1009, Sophie Laurent)**

- **Customer profile:** C-1009, Sophie Laurent, package BASIC, card ending 8125, customer since 2024-02-19, no vulnerability flag, English language.
- **Disputed transaction:** T-9050 — 2026-09-10, type `card_purchase_online`, merchant "LUMIERE DECOR SARL", amount **−129,000 HUF**, card 8125, SCA status "passed", merchant country FR, note "delivery promised by 2026-09-25". This matches the amount and date in the complaint.
- **Other transactions:** No further LUMIERE DECOR entries (no refund/credit from the merchant) and no fee transactions on the account in the period 2026-09-01 to 2026-12-31, so no fee code is in dispute and no fee rule lookup was needed.
- **Related incoming transfers:** None relevant — the complaint concerns a card purchase, not a fee waiver condition.

No assessment of the complaint is made here; the above is the factual record only.
